أبو جعفر محمد بن على بن الحسين بن زيد بن على بن الحسين بن على بن أبي طالب

notes: the chain runs on through the Prophet («عن النبي») to Jibril and God; the Prophet is never a link (rule 12), so the route is cut at Ali and Jibril and God are not written: a ruling case
«أخي إسماعيل» and «أبي موسى» are one link each, the name alone (rule 7); «آبائه» is a collective relation, not a name
the blessings after the Imams and the «[…]» editor's insertion are not chain
the Imams Ali al-Rida and Musa are narrators here (named inside the chain after «حدثني»), not imam_in_text

fixes.reason: the nisba «البغدادي» and the verb «قال» are run together without a space, so the compiler-side name cannot be cut cleanly
